title: Reality Check — Real photo or AI?
excerpt: Trust your eyes, build a streak, and beat your score in 60 seconds.
content_html:
Reality
Check

A quick game of second guesses.
Real photo or AI? Trust your eyes.

PUT YOUR INSTINCTS TO THE TEST

Think you can spot AI?

Can you tell a real photo from AI?
60 seconds to find out.

60s round10s per image

Loading the first images before the clock starts.

How to play

Choose Real photo or AI-generated with the buttons. On mobile, use Enlarge to inspect the image without accidentally answering.

Real photo or AI? Correct: +100 points. Wrong: −150 points. Each correct answer earns +150 at a 3× streak, +200 at 5×, and +300 at 10× or more. A wrong answer or timeout resets your streak. Timeouts earn 0 points. You have 60 seconds, with up to 10 seconds per image.

Keyboard: 1 Real photo · 2 AI-generated. The clock never pauses.
